create_unicode_space: create a Unicode Gymnasium space for arbitrary unicode string observations with min and max length constraints
test_unicode_contains: test the Unicode class contains method to validate if a string falls within the specified length bounds
create_anydict_space: create an AnyDict Gymnasium space that accepts any dictionary as a valid observation without schema validation
test_anydict_contains: test the AnyDict class contains method to validate if a value is a dictionary instance
review_unicode_eq: review the Unicode class equality method to compare min_length and max_length between two Unicode space instances
